title: HasVerbalComponent (spell flag)
html:
HasVerbalComponent is a spell flag which indicates whether an action is requires a verbal component to perform. Actions with verbal components can be prevented by  Silenced. This flag is used on most spells as well as some non-spell actions such as  Bardic Inspiration or  Call for Help.

This flag can be removed from applicable spells when cast with  Metamagic: Subtle Spell allowing them to be cast while silenced.
